# Game Controller sub-actions

## Get Controller State (Cuebot extra)

Reads what a game controller is doing right now (held buttons, stick positions, battery) into variables for later steps.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Controller** | Which controller to read. Type its number like #1 (the first one), part of its name, or its kind like PS5. Only the first match is read. Starts as: `#1`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%controllerConnected%` | True when that controller was found |
| `%controllerName%` | The controller's name |
| `%controllerIndex%` | The controller's number (#1 is the first one) |
| `%controllerType%` | The kind of controller, like "PS5" or "Xbox One" |
| `%batteryPercent%` | The battery level, in percent |
| `%batteryState%` | Whether it is on battery or charging |
| `%heldButtons%` | Buttons held down right now, separated by commas |
| `%axisLeftX%` | How far the left stick is pushed left-right, -1 to 1 (also axisLeftY, axisRightX, axisRightY, axisLeftTrigger, axisRightTrigger) |
| `%hat1%` | The D-pad direction, like "Up" or "Centered" |

<small>Type id: `controller.getState`</small>

## Get Controllers (Cuebot extra)

Gets the list of connected game controllers into variables for later steps.

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%controllerCount%` | How many controllers are connected |
| `%controllerNames%` | Their names, separated by commas |
| `%controller0Name%` | The first controller's name (controller1Name is the second, and so on) |
| `%controller0Index%` | The first controller's number |
| `%controller0Type%` | The first controller's kind |

<small>Type id: `controller.getList`</small>

## Rumble (Cuebot extra)

Makes a game controller vibrate for a moment. Fun as feedback when something happens, like a new follower.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Controller** | Which controller to use. Any means every connected controller. Or type its number like #1, part of its name like "DualSense", or its kind like PS5. Separate several with commas. Starts as: `Any`. |
| **Low-frequency motor (%)** | How strong the big, heavy motor is, from 0 (off) to 100 (full). Starts as: `50`. |
| **High-frequency motor (%)** | How strong the small, buzzy motor is, from 0 (off) to 100 (full). Starts as: `50`. |
| **Duration (ms)** | How long to vibrate, in milliseconds (1000 is one second). The most is 60000. Use 0 to stop vibrating. Starts as: `500`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%controllersAffected%` | How many controllers vibrated |

<small>Type id: `controller.rumble`</small>

## Set LED Colour (Cuebot extra)

Changes the colour of the light on a game controller, for controllers that have one such as the PS4 and PS5 pads.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Controller** | Which controller to use. Any means every connected controller. Or type its number like #1, part of its name like "DualSense", or its kind like PS5. Separate several with commas. Starts as: `Any`. |
| **Colour** | The colour as a hex code like #0080FF, or as three numbers like 0,128,255. Controllers without a colour light ignore it. Starts as: `#0080FF`. |

**Variables it adds**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%controllersAffected%` | How many controllers changed colour |

<small>Type id: `controller.setLed`</small>
